title: Liquid Glass rendition
question: PRODUCT.md already pins Apple-like Liquid Glass in dark mode. The live UI is still muddy frosted olive panels. Which rendition should replace it?

options.label: iOS System Glass
options.lineage: iOS 26 / WWDC Liquid Glass system chrome
options.thesis: Refractive layered system glass: clear lenses, specular rims, soft depth — gym chrome that feels like Apple’s own dark UI.
options.viewport: Mobile workout shell: translucent nav + cards over a deep near-black field; lime only on primary actions; GIFs read through clear glass edges.
options.risk: Too close to stock Apple if accent and Hebrew rhythm disappear.

options.label: Olive Brand Glass
options.lineage: Liquid Glass grammar with olive/lime brand DNA
options.thesis: Same refractive system glass, but fills and washes stay warm olive so the gym brand still owns the room.
options.viewport: Same structure as system glass, but atmosphere and panel fills stay olive-green; not muddy frosted slabs.
options.risk: Easy to slide back into today’s muddy frosted panels if tint is too heavy.

options.label: Clear Lens Minimal
options.lineage: Near-clear glass with almost no fill tint
options.thesis: Maximum clarity: nearly colorless glass so catalog GIFs and copy lead; chrome is a thin refractive shell.
options.viewport: Dark void + sharp content; nav and cards barely tinted so media and Hebrew type do the talking.
options.risk: Can feel sparse or hard to scan if hierarchy relies only on blur.
